useCustomEnabled.description: Incoming Permission state. If disabled, the default settings are used.

externalTransfer.description:
Call transfer setting.
 * `ALLOW_ALL_EXTERNAL` - All external calls are allowed.
 * `ALLOW_ONLY_TRANSFERRED_EXTERNAL` - Only externally transferred external calls are allowed.
 * `BLOCK_ALL_EXTERNAL` - All external calls are blocked.

internalCallsEnabled.description: Flag to indicate if workspace can receive internal calls.

collectCallsEnabled.description: Flag to indicate if workspace can receive collect calls.
